Markets.title: Wall Street's hidden bargains: 10 US largecap stocks trading at historic discount for investors
Markets.summary: Vested Finance reports that at least 10 US large-cap stocks are trading at 47% to 63% discounts compared to their sector valuations. This group of undervalued companies includes Comcast, AT&T, Fiserv, and Bristol-Myers Squibb.

Markets.title: Market wrap:  BSE, Nestle India, Power Grid, SBI top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian markets extended gains on Tuesday as the Sensex surged 1,225 points and the Nifty climbed 370 points. Falling crude prices, softer US Treasury yields, and foreign institutional investor buying drove the broad-based rally, led by FMCG and realty stocks.

Markets.title: FPIs pour Rs 21,715 crore into Indian stocks in 10 days; is record sell-off finally reversing?
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors poured Rs 21,715 crore into Indian equities over a 10-day period. This capital infusion indicates improving market sentiment driven by strong corporate earnings and attractive valuations.

Markets.title: European shares fall as tech stocks slide, Middle East tensions weigh
Markets.summary: European shares fell due to declining technology stocks driven by AI valuation concerns and escalating US-Iran tensions. Rising oil prices also added pressure, though healthcare stocks rose as Bayer gained 6% after increasing its 2026 profit outlook.

Markets.title: R&D-focused stocks deliver over 23% annualised returns in five years, outperform NSE 500: Monarch AIF
Markets.summary: Indian companies that increased their research and development spending delivered an average annualised return of 23.5% over five years, outperforming the NSE 500 TRI. Businesses that combined strong research growth with higher R&D intensity achieved an even higher return of 32.5%.

Markets.title: Knowledge Realty Trust NOI up 15%, declares record Rs 764 cr distribution in Q2
Markets.summary: Knowledge Realty Trust reported a 15% year-on-year increase in net operating income to Rs 1,140.4 crore for Q2 FY27. The company also declared a record distribution of Rs 764 crore, driven by strong leasing, occupancy, and rental growth.

Geo-Political.title: US strikes Iranian island ahead of midterm elections
Geo-Political.summary: The United States military has conducted limited and defensive strikes against Qeshm Island, an Iranian island. US officials stated that these attacks occurred just ahead of the midterm elections.

Geo-Political.summary: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel has died at the age of 30. He suffered the fatal injury following an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match.

Data & Insights.summary: India's illegal gold imports surged 1500% to a three-year high. These unauthorized imports bypass official duties through smuggling and individual travelers carrying small quantities in their luggage.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What is driving the surge in GST collections from imported goods?
Data & Insights.summary: GST revenue from imported goods surged 42.2% year-on-year to ₹72,246 crore in October, significantly outpacing domestic growth of about 16%. This increase was likely driven by higher import values, rupee depreciation, and stronger demand for industrial inputs.

Data & Insights.title: Can India abolish LTCG tax? SBI Research says Centre has ‘fiscal headroom’ to absorb loss, suggests alternatives
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research states that India has the financial capacity to eliminate the long-term capital gains tax by fiscal year 2028, absorbing a revenue loss of up to ₹50,000 crore. To offset this, the report recommends raising the Securities Transaction Tax by 50 percent and implementing higher exemptions and lower rates for long-term investments.

Data & Insights.title: How policy needs to catch up with India’s upcoming demographic reset
Data & Insights.summary: India has time before its youthful demographic profile shifts, but policymakers must recognize these changing numbers to update their priorities. Understanding these gradual shifts now is crucial for preparing effective economic and social policies for the future.

Data & Insights.title: India’s manufacturing growth stays strong as price pressures ease: PMI Manufacturing survey
Data & Insights.summary: India's manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index dropped slightly to 54.7 in October from 55.1 in September. Despite this minor decline, the sector's growth remained strong and stayed above both the neutral mark of 50 and its long-run average.

Data & Insights.title: Why India faces three balancing acts—and why they are tough to achieve
Data & Insights.summary: India must navigate three difficult economic trade-offs involving fuel prices, interest rates, and tax incentives. Achieving these balances is tough because policymakers must simultaneously manage affordability, saver returns, borrower costs, and fiscal stability.
